title: Conditional inverse section projection composite
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring, let $r:V\to X$ and $i:X\to V$ satisfy $i\gg r=1_X$, and let $M$ be an object of the unbounded derived category of internal $\Lambda_X$-modules. Use the projection map $\pi$ and canonical section comparisons of [def-sfb-module-projection-section-arrows], and the section arrow $a_M$ of [def-sfb-module-section-projection-arrow]. Write $U=\Lambda_X$ for the derived tensor unit and $s_M:Rr_*Ri_*M\cong M$ for the direct-image section comparison. Whenever $\pi_{r,M,Ri_*U}$ and $a_M$ are isomorphisms, define the backward endomorphism by
$$M\xrightarrow{s_M^{-1}}Rr_*Ri_*M\xrightarrow{Rr_*(a_M^{-1})}Rr_*(Lr^*M\otimes^{\mathbf L}Ri_*U)\xrightarrow{\pi_{r,M,Ri_*U}^{-1}}M\otimes^{\mathbf L}Rr_*Ri_*U\xrightarrow{1\otimes s_U}M\otimes^{\mathbf L}U\xrightarrow{\rho_M}M.$$
This is the reversed inverse path of the forward endomorphism [def-sfb-module-projection-section-composites]. This definition asserts neither identity nor invertibility.
